settings.content: We believe healing happens in relationship, and that good care is built on a strong clinical foundation. Our work draws on advanced training in trauma treatment, psychological evaluation, and integrative care, so the support you receive is both clinically rigorous and attuned to who you are.

settings.title: EMDR
settings.heading: Certified EMDR Therapist & EMDRIA Approved Consultant
settings.content: We are certified in EMDR and approved by EMDRIA to consult with other clinicians. EMDR helps the brain reprocess painful or stuck experiences, so trauma loses its grip and healing can move forward.

settings.title: TF-CBT
settings.heading: Certified Trauma-Focused CBT Therapist
settings.content: For children and teens carrying the weight of trauma, we use TF-CBT, a structured, evidence-based approach that gently reduces symptoms and helps young people, and their families, find steadier ground.

settings.title: DBT
settings.heading: Dialectical Behavior Therapy
settings.content: When emotions feel overwhelming, DBT offers concrete skills, regulation, distress tolerance, mindfulness, and healthier connection, that make daily life more livable.

settings.title: ACT
settings.heading: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy
settings.content: ACT helps when you feel stuck in avoidance or self-criticism. Together we build psychological flexibility and reconnect your daily choices with what matters most to you.

settings.title: Ecotherapy
settings.heading: Certified through the Earth Body Institute
settings.content: Some of the most grounding work happens in connection with the natural world. Our ecotherapy training brings nature-based practices into care to support reflection, regulation, and a felt sense of calm.

settings.heading: Credentials & Certifications
settings.subheading: Select an area to learn what it means for your care.

settings.title: EMDR Certified Therapist
settings.text: Advanced EMDR training that helps the brain reprocess trauma and other distressing experiences, so they no longer run the show.

settings.title: Trauma-Focused CBT (TF-CBT)
settings.text: A structured, evidence-based approach for children and adolescents impacted by trauma, supporting real symptom relief and recovery.

settings.title: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
settings.text: Extensive DBT training in emotion regulation, distress tolerance, interpersonal effectiveness, and mindfulness.

settings.title: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
settings.text: Support for psychological flexibility and values-based action, especially when avoidance or distress has you stuck.

settings.title: Ecotherapy
settings.text: Nature-based interventions woven into care to support reflection, regulation, and overall wellbeing.

settings.heading: Core Clinical Credentials
settings.subheading: The foundations our therapy is built on.

settings.title: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
settings.text: A compassionate way of understanding the different parts of ourselves, and helping them work together with less conflict.

settings.title: Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT)
settings.text: A gentle, tapping-based approach used alongside therapy to ease emotional distress and support regulation.

settings.title: Trauma-Conscious Yoga (TCY)
settings.text: Trauma-sensitive, body-based practices that support nervous-system regulation and reconnection with the body.

settings.title: Somatic Psychology (SP)
settings.text: Mind-body awareness brought into treatment, with attention to the nervous system and the embodied experience of stress and trauma.

settings.title: Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR)
settings.text: MBSR training informs how we help clients notice inner experience, soften reactivity, and respond with more intention.

settings.title: Breathwork
settings.text: Structured breathing practices that support grounding, regulation, and emotional awareness in the work of healing and growth.

settings.heading: Additional Training & Integrative Approaches
settings.subheading: The deeper toolkit we draw from to meet each person where they are.

settings.eyebrow: Curious Whether We're the Right Fit?
settings.heading: Let's start a conversation
settings.body: Tell us what you're looking for, and we'll help you find the right next step. We usually reach out within 24-48 hours.
